topic: How can we break the current limit on energy-conversion efficiencies?
scoped_question: Can a spectrally partitioned and thermally integrated PV-TPV architecture improve net useful electrical conversion under a declared source spectrum, thermal boundary, optical-loss model, and measurement protocol, relative to a reference single-converter configuration?
scientific_correction: There is no universal efficiency limit for all energy converters. A single-junction PV detailed-balance limit is conditional; exceeding it requires an architecture or assumption change, not a violation of energy conservation or thermodynamics.
